data.name: Empathy
data.description: When attempting a Sense Motive check, the snoop makes two d20 rolls and takes the higher result. If a snoop uses inspiration on a Sense Motive check, he rolls the inspiration dice twice and takes the higher result. Once per day, the snoop can expend one use of inspiration to target a single creature that he can see and hear within 30 feet. Upon doing so, the snoop detects the surface thoughts of the target's mind, as if he concentrated for 3 rounds while using the detect thoughts spell, unless the creature succeeds on a DC %1 Will saving throw.  If the target fails, the snoop can continue to detect the surface thoughts of the target creature for %2 rounds.|SnoopEmpathyDC|SnoopEmpathyDuration
